headline: Trilegal advises Paisalo on ₹300 crore NCD issuance

detail: Paisalo Digital Limited has made a public issuance of non-convertible debentures aggregating to ₹300 crore, under a shelf limit of ₹900 crore. Trilegal advised Paisalo as well as the lead manager, Tipsons Consultancy Services Limited, on this NCD issuance. The transaction team consisted of: Capital Markets team: Richa Choudhary (Partner), Avanti Kale (Counsel), Aayush Khandelwal (Senior Associate) and Associates Dinank Bhanot, Shreyansh Gupta and Sakshi Nalawade. Banking and Finance Team: Joseph Jimmy (Partner), Jinay Padh (Counsel), Yajat Bansal (Associate).
